audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer phase text sold this as a Heimerdinger lane (Heimerdinger on 4 of 7 rows, 'your core pattern starts now', 'Liandry's Torment is your spike — force fights'), while the content layer's whys already described Galio walking through the nest from level 3 onward. Win rate is 46.88% over 256 games and the packet level chart reads Heimerdinger / Skill / Galio x5.
audit.why: Galio's Shield of Durand (W) is a magic-damage-reduction channel and his build stacks MR, so the turret beams — Heimerdinger's entire damage base — are the exact damage type he is built to ignore. Heimerdinger only wins the window before W and the second Winds of War exist.
audit.corrected: Chart re-cut to match the packet, the win rate and the content whys: Heimerdinger level 1, Skill level 2, Galio from level 3 on. Difficulty raised from EVEN 6/10 to HARD 7/10, and the phase whys rewritten to say why each stage flips instead of repeating a generic 'track his dash' line.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5] named Liandry's Torment as a fight-forcing spike for Heimerdinger and phases[4] said 'Upgraded E or W deletes his all-in'. Neither survives contact with a Galio who is building MR.
audit.why: Galio's spikes are W online (level 2-3), level 6 Hero's Entrance (180s at rank 1, 4000 range), and his first MR item. Heimerdinger's only clean spike is level 1. UPGRADE!!! (R) is 100/85/70s and is a single-use kill window, not a lane-winning tool against a taunt that outranges the nest.
audit.corrected: phases[4] now states the Justice Punch into Hero's Entrance pattern; phases[5] states his MR plus W reduction blunting first-item beams; phases[6] states the 2-item MR wall.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer repeatedly told you to 'nest up and stun his Justice Punch dive' as if three turrets were a wall against it, and never stated the interaction that actually decides the matchup.
audit.why: Riot's own text for Justice Punch (E): Galio 'will briefly step back and charge, knocking up the first enemy CHAMPION he encounters' — champion, not unit. The turret nest does not body-block it. Conversely CH-3X Lightning Grenade (E) stuns only a unit DIRECTLY hit and merely slows the surrounding area, and it is a flat 11s at every rank, so a missed centre buys nothing and costs 85 mana. Justice Punch is 11/10/9/8/7s.
audit.corrected: tldr, winCon, enemyWin, dosFull[0].d and phases[4].why now state the champion-only collision and the direct-hit-only stun, with the 11s numbers attached.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0] told you to punish Justice Punch's downtime without a number.
audit.why: Justice Punch is 11s at rank 1 falling to 7s at rank 5 — a real but shrinking window, and Shield of Durand's 18s rank-1 cooldown is the longer and more punishable one.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1] read 'Drop turrets in one sweep range' with a description about burning a cooldown. Galio has no sweep and the description described no Galio ability.
audit.why: The real clumping punish is Winds of War (Q), which converges into one large tornado dealing damage over time.
audit.corrected: Retitled to the Q tornado and the description now names Winds of War's convergence.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page said Galio can cut a dashless Heimerdinger's retreat.
audit.why: Justice Punch charges through and knocks up, and Heimerdinger has no dash anywhere in his kit.
audit.corrected: Folded into winCon and tldr: Flash is reserved for his E, not for damage.

notes: suspectNames flagged 'Hit Justice Punch' in wants.foe[2] as a probable wrong ability name — FALSE POSITIVE.
